name: 侠客梦
english_description: A wuxia MUD from the same "Ode to Gallantry I" codebase lineage as this project's jym (Jin Yong's Dream) and xkx2000zxb -- all three are separately circulating copies of one underlying archive, sharing the same simul_efuns and the same roughly 50-zone map skeleton (Taihu Ancient Tomb, Kunlun, Shaolin, Wudang, Emei, the Beggars' Sect, the Sun-Moon Holy Cult, Peach Blossom Island, and more), though xkm's own registration flow adds two steps unique to this copy -- confirming you've read the "Xiake Meng player code of conduct" and supplying a QQ number -- so its connection sequence should not be assumed identical to jym's. New characters wash up on the beach at Xiakedao ("Isle of the Chivalrous"), greeted by a smiling fisherman, before heading out to join sects and build a reputation. Its standout mechanic is a custom equipment-forging system: high-level players who gather rare materials (a sea-bottom "Golden Mother" relic, thousand-year spirit wood) can commission the legendary smith Mo Ye to forge a weapon or suit of armor at the Mysterious-Weapon Ancient Cave, temper it through training, and pay the Taoist master Zhang Tianshi at a Western-Regions immortal's cave to socket it with gems earned by killing assassins or exploring a maze. Dying more than 200 times without reaching 50,000 combat experience permanently locks a character in a death-penalty room. §10.7 deep testing walked the newbie tutorial, turn-based combat against bandits on the Wudang mountain road, and the bulletin board, and found one previously unrecorded bug: a missing condition-check file broke the board's per-read cooldown throttle and threw a runtime error on every read, present in the archive since 2002 (AGENTS.md §7.83).
